verdict.rationale: Apify is a web scraping/automation platform providing Actors, data extraction, and an MCP server so external AI agents can discover and use Actors, but there is no evidence of Apify itself generating AI insights, summaries, or suggestions from a user's scraped data inside the product. The MCP server (apify-docs-10, apify-probe-3) enables external LLMs to consume Apify's tools, which is a different capability from the product surfacing AI-generated analysis of the user's own data. Missing for 10: any built-in AI analysis/insight feature, in-product LLM summarization of datasets, or suggestion engine acting on stored data.
